    if not resp: # empty list
        break

        batch=resp
    else:
        batch=resp.get('comments') or resp.get('data') or []
    if not batch:
        break
    comments.extend(batch)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

    print('id', c.get('task_comment_id'), 'author', c.get('user',{}).get('email'), 'at', c.get('created_at'), 'content:\n', c.get('content'))

# Parse playlist_id from any URL in comments
import re
playlist_ids=set()
for c in comments:
    text=c.get('content','')
    for m in re.finditer(r'/playlists/(\d+)', text):
        playlist_ids.add(int(m.group(1)))
print('parsed playlist_ids', playlist_ids)

# Parse add/remove lines

removes=[]
for c in comments:
    text=c.get('content','')

            # payload format: "Title by Artist" (assumed)

        return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
    # fallback: entire string as title
    return s.strip(), None

# Todoist parsing for add/remove suggestions
access_token_todoist = apis.todoist.login(username='anita.burch@gmail.com', password=']dI#3dt')['access_token']

todo_task_id = 6341
comments=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(access_token=access_token_todoist, task_id=todo_task_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    if isinstance(resp, list):
        batch=resp
    else:
        batch=resp.get('comments') or resp.get('data') or []
    if not batch:
        break
    comments.extend(batch)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:

adds=[]
removes=[]
for c in comments:
    text=c.get('content','')
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line=line.strip()
        lower=line.lower()
        if lower.startswith('add =>'):
            payload=line[len('add =>'):].strip()
            adds.append(payload)
        elif lower.startswith('remove =>'):
            payload=line[len('remove =>'):].strip()
            removes.append(payload)

# Parse "Title by Artist" -> (title, artist)
def parse_title_artist(s):
    if ' by ' in s:
        title, artist = s.split(' by ', 1)
        return title.strip(), artist.strip()
    return s.strip(), None

add_items=[parse_title_artist(x) for x in adds]
remove_items=[parse_title_artist(x) for x in removes]

print('Parsed add_items:', add_items)
print('Parsed remove_items:', remove_items)

# Fetch current spotify playlist
spotify_access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='anita.burch@gmail.com', password='&vSsyZ1')['access_token']
playlist_id=654
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(access_token=spotify_access_token, playlist_id=playlist_id)
current_songs = pl['songs']

print('Current playlist title:', pl.get('title'))
print('Current song count:', len(current_songs))

# Map current songs by (title, any artist)
# We'll use exact case-insensitive match on title and artist name.

def normalize(x):
    return x.strip().lower() if isinstance(x,str) else x

current_tuples=[]
for s in current_songs:
    title=normalize(s.get('title'))
    artist_names=[normalize(a.get('name')) for a in s.get('artists',[])]
    current_tuples.append((s['id'], title, artist_names))

# Determine which current songs correspond to removal suggestions
remove_song_ids=[]
remove_match_rows=[]
for (title, artist) in remove_items:
    nt=normalize(title)
    na=normalize(artist) if artist else None
    matched=[]
    for song_id, stitle, artist_names in current_tuples:
        if stitle==nt and (na is None or na in artist_names):
            matched.append(song_id)
    remove_match_rows.append({'title':title,'artist':artist,'matched_song_ids':matched})
    # if multiple matches, keep all for safety? better keep all matched for that suggestion.
    remove_song_ids.extend(matched)

# Determine duplicates in remove_song_ids
remove_song_ids_unique=sorted(set(remove_song_ids))
print('Remove match rows:')
for r in remove_match_rows:
    print(r)
print('Unique remove song ids to perform:', remove_song_ids_unique)

# Search for songs to add and select exact matches

def search_song_ids_exact(title, artist):
    # search across all pages
    q = f"{title} {artist}".strip()
    page_index=0
    all_results=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_access_token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        # resp might be list or dict
        if isinstance(resp, dict):
            # try keys
            results = resp.get('songs') or resp.get('data') or resp.get('results') or []
        else:
            results = resp or []
        if not results:
            break
        all_results.extend(results)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    # filter exact match title + artist
    nt=normalize(title)
    na=normalize(artist)
    exact=[]
    for r in all_results:
        if normalize(r.get('title'))!=nt:
            continue
        artist_names=[normalize(a.get('name')) for a in r.get('artists',[])]
        if na in artist_names:
            exact.append(r)
    return exact

add_song_ids_unique=[]
add_match_rows=[]
for (title, artist) in add_items:
    exact = search_song_ids_exact(title, artist)
    candidate_ids=[r['song_id'] for r in exact]
    add_match_rows.append({'title':title,'artist':artist,'candidate_song_ids':candidate_ids,'num_candidates':len(candidate_ids)})

print('Add match rows (exact search results):')
for r in add_match_rows:
    print(r)

# Choose song id to add: if exact candidates >1, keep all? that's risky.
# We'll only proceed if exactly 1 candidate; if 0, skip; if >1, skip for safety.
for r in add_match_rows:
    ids = r['candidate_song_ids']

        add_song_ids_unique.append(ids[0])
    else:
        pass
add_song_ids_unique=sorted(set(add_song_ids_unique))
print('Proposed add song ids to perform (unique, only if exactly 1 match):', add_song_ids_unique)

# But also avoid adding songs already in playlist
current_ids=set([s['id'] for s in current_songs])
add_to_perform=[sid for sid in add_song_ids_unique if sid not in current_ids]
print('Current song ids already in playlist:', sorted(list(current_ids))[:10],'... total',len(current_ids))
print('Add to perform after excluding already present:', add_to_perform)

print('\nACTION SUMMARY')
print('to_remove', remove_song_ids_unique, 'count', len(remove_song_ids_unique))
print('to_add', add_to_perform, 'count', len(add_to_perform))

# Build verification table for removals

for r in remove_match_rows:
    # include whether any matched
    print(f"{r['title']} | {r['artist']} | will_remove={bool(r['matched_song_ids'])} | matched={r['matched_song_ids']}")

# Build verification table for adds

    print(f"{r['title']} | {r['artist']} | candidate_count={r['num_candidates']} | chosen={(add_to_perform[r['candidate_song_ids'][0]] if False else '')}")

# Prepare chosen mapping for adds: title+artist -> chosen song id if unique match
chosen_map={}
for r in add_match_rows:
    if r['num_candidates']==1:
        chosen_map[(normalize(r['title']), normalize(r['artist']))]=r['candidate_song_ids'][0]

chosen_add_rows=[]
for (title, artist) in add_items:
    key=(normalize(title), normalize(artist))
    if key in chosen_map and chosen_map[key] in add_to_perform:
        chosen_add_rows.append({'title':title,'artist':artist,'song_id':chosen_map[key]})

print('Chosen add rows:', chosen_add_rows)

            batch = resp.get('comments') or resp.get('data') or []
        if not batch:

        comments.extend(batch)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:

    adds=[]

            return t.strip(), a.strip()
